Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the MAP and the redline. A couple quick items from Legal and Procurement:
1) Procurement wants the final redline in a single PDF with numbered change log before routing to our CFO; will OlivePay also need to countersign? Our procurement team uses OlivePay for payment processing and wants the vendor contact on the contract.
2) Security asked for an explicit KMS key flow diagram plus confirmation that we can provide a dedicated key if required.
3) Start date is okay in principle, but our operations lead requests a one-week buffer after signature to confirm network peering. Practically we could move the start to 2026-02-23 if needed.

Carlos and I will discuss internally this afternoon. If you can produce a DocuSign envelope for 02/11 signing with the current redline appended, that will speed us up — but Procurement prefers to see the consolidated redline PDF first.

Best,
